CO.ProvenanceSummary: Colorado taxes modified federal taxable income at a flat 4.4% rate.
CO.ProvenanceCitation: Colorado Department of Revenue Individual Income Tax Guide and Individual Income Tax FAQ (official published flat rate 4.4%).

VA.ProvenanceSummary: Virginia taxable income starts from federal adjusted gross income, reduced here by Virginia's published standard deduction before applying the official Virginia individual rate schedule.
VA.ProvenanceCitation: Virginia Tax Deductions page (standard deduction amounts) and Miscellaneous Filing page (individual income tax rate schedule).

ProvenanceSummary: Planner-grade default bundle for 2026 projection starts. Federal tax, capital-gains, standard-deduction, NIIT, IRMAA, RMD, Colorado, and Virginia tables are pinned to named official-source inputs with explicit future-year extrapolation rules.

SourceProvenance.SourceCitation: IRS IR-2025-103 and Revenue Procedure 2025-32, tax year 2026 standard deduction amounts.
SourceProvenance.TransformationNotes: Mapped IRS filing-status labels to engine filing-status keys without rounding.

SourceProvenance.SourceCitation: Revenue Procedure 2025-32, Section 4.01, 2026 tax rate tables.
SourceProvenance.TransformationNotes: Converted IRS bracket endpoints into lower-bound, upper-bound, rate rows by filing status.

SourceProvenance.SourceCitation: Revenue Procedure 2025-32, Section 4.03, maximum capital gains rate thresholds for 2026.
SourceProvenance.TransformationNotes: Modeled 0%, 15%, and 20% qualified dividend and long-term capital gain bands by filing status.

SourceProvenance.SourceCitation: IRS Net Investment Income Tax page, statutory 3.8% rate and filing-status thresholds.
SourceProvenance.TransformationNotes: Stored statutory thresholds as fixed-dollar values because they are not indexed in this engine contract.

SourceProvenance.SourceCitation: SSA Monthly Medicare Premiums for 2026 chart for Part B and prescription drug coverage IRMAA tiers.
SourceProvenance.TransformationNotes: Stored the income thresholds and monthly Part B and Part D surcharge components; standard premium amounts are not modeled as surcharges.

SourceProvenance.SourceCitation: IRS Notice 2022-6, Appendix A, Uniform Lifetime Table.
SourceProvenance.TransformationNotes: Stored age-to-divisor rows for ages 72 through 120.

SourceProvenance.SourceName: Colorado Department of Revenue and Virginia Tax
SourceProvenance.SourceCitation: Official Colorado flat individual income tax rate guidance and Virginia standard deduction and individual income tax rate schedule guidance.
SourceProvenance.TransformationNotes: Bundled CO and VA as the currently supported state profiles; unsupported states remain explicit missing-profile warnings.

ExtrapolationRules.RuleDescription: Use the 2026 planner-grade base table for the start year; future projection years follow the engine's deterministic tax-bracket inflation path rather than a refreshed statutory bundle.
ExtrapolationRules.ProvenanceNote: Refresh this bundle when IRS publishes a later annual revenue procedure.

ExtrapolationRules.RuleDescription: Use the 2026 planner-grade base standard deduction amounts; future years follow the engine's deterministic inflation path.
ExtrapolationRules.ProvenanceNote: Refresh this bundle when IRS publishes a later annual revenue procedure.

ExtrapolationRules.RuleDescription: Use the 2026 planner-grade base preferential-rate thresholds; future years follow the engine's deterministic inflation path.
ExtrapolationRules.ProvenanceNote: Refresh this bundle when IRS publishes a later annual revenue procedure.

ExtrapolationRules.RuleDescription: Carry statutory NIIT thresholds forward as fixed nominal values unless Congress changes the law.
ExtrapolationRules.ProvenanceNote: The engine intentionally does not inflate NIIT thresholds.

ExtrapolationRules.RuleDescription: Use the published 2026 IRMAA tiers as the base table; future projection years use the engine's deterministic projection behavior until a later CMS/SSA table bundle is added.
ExtrapolationRules.ProvenanceNote: Refresh annually after CMS and SSA publish the next premium and IRMAA tables.

ExtrapolationRules.RuleDescription: Use the IRS Uniform Lifetime Table divisors as fixed regulatory age factors.
ExtrapolationRules.ProvenanceNote: Refresh only if IRS updates the life expectancy tables.

ExtrapolationRules.RuleDescription: Use bundled CO and VA state profiles as current-law state approximations; future years keep the stated profiles unless a new bundle updates them.
ExtrapolationRules.ProvenanceNote: Add state-specific annual refreshes before treating long-horizon state tax as statutory reference data.
